title: After Using the Side Dish Shop Connection for a Job Lead
description:
Two months since you used a tip from the side dish shop part-time job to land a work opportunity.
You hadn't known how that connection had played out.
Today the shop owner called.

choices.result_text:
You thanked them.
The owner asked, "Did things work out?"
A small connection — can change the direction of a life.

You caught up.
The owner said to reach out if there was anything else they could help with.
Connections don't end with just one encounter.

title: After Becoming a Regular at the Side Dish Shop
description:
Two months since you became a regular at the side dish shop.
You'd become a familiar face.
Today the owner spoke to you first when you walked in.

choices.result_text:
You had a warm exchange.
Becoming a regular — means belonging to that space.
Having somewhere you belong gives life a sense of stability.

You were in a hurry.
The owner smiled and said, "Busy day?" and packed things up for you.
Being a regular — means someone looks out for you even on a rushed day.

title: After Taking a Short-Term Interior Job
description:
Two months since you took that short-term interior work.
The experience had accumulated.
Today a similar job came in again.

choices.result_text:
You took it.
You adapted faster than the first time.
Skills learned through the body — accumulate, and the speed changes.

choices.text: Negotiate for better terms this time
choices.result_text:
You negotiated.
With experience behind you, you don't have to just take what's offered.
The difference between the first time and the second — is leverage.

title: After Becoming a Site Manager
description:
Two months since you took on the interior site management role.
The responsibility had shifted.
Today a situation came up where you had to decide on your own for the first time.

choices.result_text:
You made the call.
Whether it was right or wrong, you'd find out later.
A manager — is someone who is trusted to decide.

You checked upstairs.
Better to confirm than to get it wrong, you thought.
But always checking — keeps a manager from growing.

title: After Getting Close with the Gosiwon Neighbor
description:
Two months since you got close with the neighbor in the gosiwon.
Small greetings had continued.
Today the neighbor looked like they were having a hard time.

choices.result_text:
You said something.
The neighbor said, "Nothing big, but thanks."
Getting closer — gains meaning in moments like this.

You watched from a distance.
You told yourself you'd say something when the moment was right.
The closer the relationship, the easier it is to just say something.

title: After Warning a Potential Victim
description:
Two months since you warned someone they were about to be scammed.
You hadn't known how things turned out for them.
Today they reached out.

choices.result_text:
They told you they'd heard the warning.
And avoided it.
One warning — had kept someone from being hurt.

You said you were relieved.
They said so too.
A single word had made this conversation possible.

title: After Entering Politics
description:
Two months since you decided to run for office.
The preparation had been more complicated than expected.
Today the first poll on your support came out.

choices.result_text:
You looked at the numbers.
Numbers aren't everything.
But they show you where you're standing right now.

You reworked the strategy.
Principle alone won't carry you in politics.
Holding to your principles while changing your strategy — that's the hard part.

title: After Winning the Election
description:
Two months since you won the election.
You had authority now.
Today came the first situation where you actually had to use it.

choices.result_text:
You started with what you'd promised.
What you said before the win — becomes the benchmark after it.
The first use of power defines the whole.

You took stock of the situation.
The gap between promises and reality — is what makes politics hard.
Acting without understanding leads to mistakes.

title: After Choosing an Aggressive Endgame Strategy
description:
Two months since you chose an aggressive strategy in the final stretch.
You'd made a big bet.
Today the results came in.

choices.result_text:
An aggressive strategy — wins big when it works, loses big when it doesn't.
Either way — choosing it meant accepting the result.

choices.text: Shift part of the position to defense now
choices.result_text:
You moved part of the position to defense.
All offense doesn't keep you alive.
Balancing attack and defense — is the skill of the final stretch.

title: After Choosing a Defensive Endgame Strategy
description:
Two months since you chose a strategy focused on protecting what you'd built.
Preserving what you'd accumulated had been the priority.
Today you looked at how that strategy had played out.

choices.result_text:
You checked the numbers.
A defensive strategy — doesn't lose big.
But it doesn't grow big either.
Which you chose determines the final number.

choices.text: See if there's room to go after additional opportunities
choices.result_text:
You looked for room.
Even with a defensive strategy — opportunities come.
Protecting and watching for chances — that's what defense really means.

title: After Choosing to Look Back at the End
description:
Two months since you chose to look back at the road you'd traveled in the final stretch.
You'd been thinking about meaning more than numbers.
Today you looked back at five years.

choices.result_text:
It had been meaningful.
Money wasn't everything.
These five years — had been filled with things you could only learn by living them.

It wasn't over.
Looking back — doesn't mean stopping.
You can look back and still move forward.

title: After Agreeing to Cover Your Parents' Debt
description:
Two months since you agreed to take on your parents' debt.
The burden had been piling up.
Today your parents called.

choices.result_text:
You picked up.
Your parents said, "Thank you."
Taking on the debt — had come back as gratitude.
But the burden was still real.

You told them honestly.
Your parents said, "We're sorry."
Honesty — is a way to share the weight.

title: After Paying Off Your Parents' Debt in Full
description:
Two months since you paid off your parents' debt entirely.
It had taken a long time.
Today your father called.

choices.result_text:
You answered warmly.
Your father asked, "How are you holding up?"
The debt being gone — had let the relationship start fresh.

You asked what was going on.
"Just calling," he said.
Being able to just call — was what had changed.

title: After Resolving the Guarantee Issue Through Compromise
description:
Two months since you wrapped up the guarantee issue through a compromise.
It hadn't been a complete resolution.
Today you saw how the results of that compromise were playing out.

choices.text: Feel the compromise was the right call
choices.result_text:
It was right.
Even if incomplete — a moving compromise can be better than blocked justice.
Compromise is not defeat.

It still felt incomplete.
But an incomplete resolution is better than none.
Waiting for a perfect solution and doing nothing — is the worse choice.

title: After the Mystery Tip Paid Off
description:
Two months since you bet on the mystery tip and it worked.
Since then, similar information had come in again.
Today you had to decide what to do.

choices.result_text:
You bet again.
Just because it worked once doesn't mean it'll work next time.
But the memory of it working — makes you bet again.

You verified it first.
You checked the source of the information.
If one success doesn't make you believe blindly — that's when experience becomes a real lesson.
